title: net.icelander.utv operations
description: The public entrypoints of the typed API and of the 0.2 JSON layer, without accessors, toJson and toString. Every one is a pure query; overloads are folded into one entry where they behave the same. Static methods are listed as exported functions; the entrypoint names their class.

entities.name: Make a date
entities.description: A CivilDate from a year (long or BigInteger), a month and a day.
failures: IllegalArgumentException, its message naming the reason (month-out-of-range, day-out-of-range), when the day cannot exist.

entities.name: Make a date, or learn why not
entities.description: Like of, but reports a day that cannot exist as an outcome.
failures: Invalid (month-out-of-range) for a month outside 1–12.
Invalid (day-out-of-range) for a day the month lacks, such as 30 February or 29 February 2026.

entities.name: Add days to a date
entities.description: Days (or, with addWeeks, weeks) later or earlier; always has an answer.

entities.name: Add months to a date
entities.description: Month arithmetic that refuses to invent a day (the default MonthEnd.REJECT). addYears(n) works the same way.
entities.result: Outcome.Unique with the CivilDate when the day exists in the target month.
failures: None (month-end) when the day is missing from the target month (31 January + 1 month; 29 February + 1 year).

entities.name: Add months, clamping to the month's end
entities.description: The total overload addMonths(n, MonthEnd.CONSTRAIN) (and addYears(n, policy)): clamps to the last day of the target month.
entities.result: The CivilDate, clamped to the month's last day when the day is missing.
failures: IllegalArgumentException when the policy is not MonthEnd.CONSTRAIN; the rejecting form is addMonths(n).

entities.name: Add a period to a date
entities.description: Years and months first, then weeks and days.
failures: None (month-end) when the intermediate day does not exist.
Invalid (kind-mismatch) when the period has hours, minutes or seconds.

entities.name: Count the days between two dates
entities.description: Days from this date to another, negative when the other is earlier.

entities.name: Add months to a month
entities.description: Months (or, with addYears, years) on a CivilYearMonth; a month has no missing day.

entities.name: Make a date-time, or learn why not
entities.description: A floating wall-clock date-time from its fields.
failures: Invalid (month-out-of-range, day-out-of-range, field-out-of-range) for a field out of range.
Unsupported (leap-second) for second 60.

entities.name: Add wall-clock time to a date-time
entities.description: Hours (and, with the sibling methods, days, weeks, minutes or seconds) as wall-clock arithmetic, carrying into days.

entities.name: Add months to a date-time
entities.description: Month arithmetic on a date-time; add(Period) adds every component.
failures: None (month-end) when the day is missing from the target month.
IllegalArgumentException from addMonths(n, policy) when the policy is not MonthEnd.CONSTRAIN.

entities.name: Load zone rules
entities.description: Reads a rule bundle in the format of conformance/rules/demo-zones.json from a file the caller names (parse reads text; tryParse reports a bad bundle as an outcome).
failures: IOException when the file cannot be read.
IllegalArgumentException when it is not a well-formed bundle; tryParse returns invalid (malformed-value) instead.

entities.name: Hold the rules in a context
entities.description: Wraps loaded rules for the zone operations. There is no default context.
failures: NullPointerException when the rules are null.

entities.name: Put a wall time in a zone
entities.description: A ZonedIntent: this wall time in a named IANA zone, an intention resolved later.
failures: IllegalArgumentException when the zone id is not Area/Location-shaped.

entities.name: Pin a wall time to an offset
entities.description: A FixedOffsetDateTime at an offset in seconds.
failures: IllegalArgumentException (offset-out-of-range) beyond ±18:00.

entities.name: The instant of an offset date-time
entities.description: Needs no zone rules.

entities.name: Resolve a zoned wall time
entities.description: The instant(s) a ZonedIntent names under the context's rules, with ResolutionPolicy.STRICT or the policy given (a ResolutionPolicy, a Gap or an Overlap).
entities.result: Outcome.Unique with the Instant, or Multiple with both instants of an overlap, ascending.
failures: Unsupported (unknown-zone) when the zone is not in the rules.
Unsupported (outside-rule-window) within a day of the rules' validity window or outside it.
Invalid (offset-mismatch) when an asserted offset is not in force.
None (gap) for a wall time in a gap, with Gap.REJECT or PRESERVE_UNRESOLVED; Gap.SHIFT_FORWARD gives the shifted instant instead.
Multiple (ambiguous) for a wall time in an overlap with Overlap.REJECT; ALL gives Multiple without the diagnostic; EARLIEST and LATEST give Unique.

entities.name: Add wall-clock time to a zoned value
entities.description: Days (and, with the sibling methods, weeks, hours, minutes or seconds) in the same zone; the wall time is kept, whatever the DST rules.
entities.result: The ZonedIntent, without any asserted offset (the JSON layer reports offset-assertion-dropped, info).

entities.name: Add months to a zoned value
entities.description: Month arithmetic in the same zone.
failures: None (month-end) when the day is missing from the target month.

entities.name: See an instant in a zone
entities.description: The wall time in a named zone, with the offset in force asserted (also TemporalContext.inZone).
failures: Unsupported (unknown-zone) when the zone is not in the rules.
Unsupported (outside-rule-window) outside the rules' validity window.
Unsupported (implementation-limit) for a fraction of a second finer than a nanosecond.

entities.name: Order two values that may need zone rules
entities.description: Resolves zoned values strictly, then compares; values without a zone compare as compareTo would.
entities.result: Outcome.Unique with an Ordering (BEFORE, EQUAL, AFTER).
failures: Multiple with the possible orders and one ambiguous warning when the order depends on which side of an overlap is meant.
None (gap), Unsupported (unknown-zone, outside-rule-window) or Invalid (offset-mismatch) when a zoned side cannot be resolved.
Unsupported (unsupported-operand) when a zoned value is compared with anything but an Instant, a FixedOffsetDateTime or another ZonedIntent, or two unzoned values of different kinds or forms.

entities.name: Make an instant
entities.description: Seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z plus nanoseconds (fromUnixNanoseconds takes nanoseconds alone), held exactly.

entities.name: Move an instant by POSIX seconds
entities.description: add(PosixSeconds): exact rational arithmetic, so a third of a second stays a third.

entities.name: Move an instant by SI seconds
entities.description: add(ElapsedSeconds): refused, because SI seconds on a POSIX coordinate need a leap-second table.
failures: Unsupported (needs-leap-seconds), always.

entities.name: Measure between two instants
entities.description: The exact POSIX seconds from this instant to another, as a reduced fraction.

entities.name: See an instant at an offset
entities.description: The wall time at a fixed offset in seconds.
failures: IllegalArgumentException beyond ±18:00.
ArithmeticException when the instant has a fraction finer than a nanosecond.

entities.name: Make a range
entities.description: An interval of dates or instants from two Bounds (halfOpen, closed and of throw instead of returning an outcome).
failures: Invalid (reversed-interval) when the end is before the start.
Unsupported (unsupported-form) when neither end has a point.

entities.name: Test whether a range contains a point
entities.description: Three-valued: unknown ends make some answers possible.
entities.result: A Truth: DEFINITELY, POSSIBLY or IMPOSSIBLE.

entities.name: Test whether two ranges overlap
entities.description: Three-valued; dates are normalized to half-open first.

entities.name: Parse text
entities.description: Reads any text-form value into the sealed TemporalValue (Instant for Z, FixedOffsetDateTime for +00:00, …). Each type's own parse reads the same text and answers kind-mismatch for another kind.
failures: Invalid (syntax) for text outside the grammar.
Invalid (day-out-of-range, month-out-of-range, field-out-of-range, offset-out-of-range, reversed-interval, kind-mismatch).
Unsupported (unsupported-form) for week, ordinal and basic dates, EDTF qualifiers, decimal period components and intervals without any point.
Unsupported (unsupported-annotation, leap-second, end-of-day).

entities.name: Read UTV JSON as a typed value
entities.description: Each type's fromJson, or TemporalValue.fromJson for any of them.
failures: Invalid (kind-mismatch) for the wrong kind or form.
Invalid (malformed-value), with the 0.1 structural code beside it, for JSON of the wrong shape.
Unsupported (unsupported-operand) for a valid value no typed type can hold, such as a zoned date or a date-time with a resolutionPolicy.
Unsupported (implementation-limit) for a period component beyond 64 bits; unsupported (leap-second) for second 60.

entities.name: Take the one answer
entities.description: The value of a Unique outcome (tryGetUnique and uniqueOr are the non-throwing forms).
failures: OutcomeException, carrying the status and diagnostics, for every case but Unique.

entities.name: Bring in a java.time.Instant
entities.description: Exact, so a clock reading taken by the caller (Instant.now()) goes in unchanged. Instant.from(OffsetDateTime) reads an OffsetDateTime as the instant it names.

entities.name: Convert an instant to java.time.Instant
entities.description: Convert an instant to java.time.Instant.
failures: Unique with a precision-loss warning when a fraction finer than a nanosecond is truncated.
Unsupported (out-of-native-range) outside java.time.Instant's range.

entities.name: Convert a date to LocalDate
entities.description: Convert a date to LocalDate.
failures: Unsupported (out-of-native-range) beyond LocalDate's years.

entities.name: Bring in an OffsetDateTime as a wall time
entities.description: The wall time at its offset (the instant is Instant.from).

entities.name: Convert to OffsetDateTime
entities.description: Exact: the round trip gives back an equal OffsetDateTime.
failures: Unsupported (out-of-native-range) beyond java.time's years.

entities.name: Bring in a ZonedDateTime
entities.description: The wall time and zone, with the offset java.time chose as the asserted offset.
failures: IllegalArgumentException when the zone is a ZoneOffset; use FixedOffsetDateTime.from.

entities.name: Convert a zoned value to ZonedDateTime
entities.description: Checks the asserted offset against the JDK's tz database.
failures: Unsupported (unsupported-operand) without an asserted offset: resolve first, or come from Instant.inZone.
Invalid (offset-mismatch) when the JDK's tz database disagrees with the asserted offset.
Unsupported (unknown-zone) when the JDK does not know the zone; unsupported (out-of-native-range) beyond java.time's years.

entities.name: Validate UTV JSON structurally
entities.description: Parses with duplicate-key detection, then checks the envelope, the version, the kind and its properties.
failures: Invalid (duplicate-key, at the repeated key) for a repeated key; invalid (utv.json.malformed) for text that is not JSON.
Unsupported (utv.version.unsupported) for a well-formed version other than utv/1.0; invalid (utv.envelope.schema) for a malformed or missing identifier such as utv/4.
Invalid (utv.kind.unknown, utv.value.required, utv.value.unknown-property, utv.envelope.unknown-property) for unknown kinds and missing or unknown properties.

entities.name: Validate a Gregorian civil value
entities.description: Structural validation, then the proleptic Gregorian calendar for year, year-month, date and datetime forms.
failures: Any structural outcome first.
Unsupported (utv.unsupported) for other calendars, kinds or forms.
Invalid (month-out-of-range, day-out-of-range, field-out-of-range, utv.civil.fields, utv.civil.year).

entities.name: Parse ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 / RFC 9557 text
entities.description: The 0.2 parser; parseText adds periods and intervals on top of it.
entities.result: UtvResult unique with the UTV value.
failures: The same invalid and unsupported outcomes as TemporalValue.parse for points.

entities.name: Format ISO text
entities.description: Format ISO text.
entities.result: UtvResult unique with the text as a JSON string.
failures: Unsupported (unsupported-operand) for other kinds and for a zone on anything but a date-time; unsupported (leap-second); unsupported (no-text-form) for an offset with seconds or a fraction with no finite decimal.

entities.name: Parse the text form (JSON layer)
entities.description: Parse the text form (JSON layer).
entities.result: UtvResult unique with the UTV value.
failures: As TemporalValue.parse.

entities.name: Format the text form (JSON layer)
entities.description: Format the text form (JSON layer).
entities.result: UtvResult unique with the text as a JSON string.
failures: Unsupported (no-text-form) for mixed-sign periods, exact second counts, start-amount intervals and other kinds.

entities.name: Calendar fields of a date
entities.description: Day of week (Monday 1), day of year, ISO week and week year, days in month, leap year.
entities.result: UtvResult unique with an object of the fields.
failures: Unsupported (unsupported-operand) for forms other than date and datetime; unsupported (unsupported-calendar); invalid for a date that does not exist.

entities.name: Add an amount (JSON layer)
entities.description: A calendar amount to a civil value, or POSIX seconds to an instant, with a MonthEnd or JSON policy.
entities.result: UtvResult unique with the new value; info offset-assertion-dropped when an asserted offset was removed.
failures: None (month-end).
Invalid (kind-mismatch): time components on a date, a calendar amount on an instant, a second argument that is not an amount.
Unsupported (needs-leap-seconds) for SI seconds on an instant; unsupported (unsupported-operand) for a time of day; unsupported (unsupported-policy) for an unknown policy.

entities.name: Compare two values (JSON layer)
entities.description: Compare two values (JSON layer).
failures: Unsupported (needs-zone-rules) for anything in a named zone.
Unsupported (unsupported-operand) for different kinds or forms, or an unzoned value against an offset one.

entities.name: Days between two dates (JSON layer)
entities.description: Days between two dates (JSON layer).
failures: Unsupported (unsupported-operand) unless both are dates; unsupported (different-zones) unless both have the same zone or none.

entities.name: POSIX seconds between two instants (JSON layer)
entities.description: POSIX seconds between two instants (JSON layer).
entities.result: UtvResult unique with a posixSeconds amount.
failures: Unsupported (unsupported-operand) for anything but POSIX instants.

entities.name: Contains (JSON layer)
entities.description: Contains (JSON layer).
failures: Unsupported (unsupported-operand) for other constructions, domains or point kinds; unsupported (different-zones).

entities.name: Overlaps (JSON layer)
entities.description: Overlaps (JSON layer).
failures: Unsupported (unsupported-operand) when the domains differ; unsupported (different-zones).

entities.name: Resolve (JSON layer)
entities.description: With a ResolutionPolicy, a JSON policy, or the value's own resolutionPolicy.
entities.result: UtvResult unique or multiple with instants.
failures: Symbolic (no-zone) for an unzoned date-time.
Unsupported (unsupported-operand) for anything but a civil date-time; unsupported (needs-zone-rules) without rules; unsupported (unknown-zone, outside-rule-window, leap-second, unsupported-policy).
Invalid (offset-mismatch); none (gap); multiple (ambiguous).

entities.name: To a zone (JSON layer)
entities.description: To a zone (JSON layer).
entities.result: UtvResult unique with a zoned date-time carrying offsetAssertion.
failures: Unsupported (needs-zone-rules, unknown-zone, outside-rule-window, implementation-limit).

entities.name: To an offset (JSON layer)
entities.description: To an offset (JSON layer).
entities.result: UtvResult unique with a fixed-offset date-time.
failures: Invalid (offset-out-of-range); unsupported (implementation-limit).

entities.name: Bring in a java.util.Date (JSON layer)
entities.description: Bring in a java.util.Date (JSON layer).
entities.result: UtvResult unique with an instant, for As.INSTANT.
failures: Unsupported (local-zone) for any civil reading: Date's fields come from ZoneId.systemDefault().

entities.name: Bring in an OffsetDateTime with an intent (JSON layer)
entities.description: As.INSTANT, OFFSET_DATE_TIME or LOCAL_DATE_TIME.
entities.result: A UTV instant, fixed-offset date-time or floating date-time.

relatedViews.relationship: The use cases that call them.
